chapter: Club Alabam and the Europe contract
title: Winter Garden Sundays and Loew's vaudeville, never the Palace
summary: Wooding played Sunday concerts at the Winter Garden and Loew's vaudeville but never the Palace until accompanying Rae Harrison.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But before that, then Lyons would start playing the Winter Garden. Every Sunday night, we started putting a show into the Winter Garden. I played the Winter Garden I guess, during around a year, I guess about 10 times. Sunday night concerts. And we was doing vaudeville at different times. And we started vaudeville when we was there, at Loew's vaudeville.
See, I never played the Palace, because that was in opposition to Loew's State. And we never could play the Palace, see.
So then we went on at noontime. The only time I ever played the Palace was accompanying Ray Harrison. Ray Harrison later on played the Palace after -- she was one of the first
who went in women to play the Palace. And I was in the pit.
